hints.title: Lookup Set Membership
hints.text: Insert all numbers into a membership lookup set for constant-time existence checks.

hints.title: Negative Complement Check
hints.text: For each positive integer x, check if -x is also present in the hash set.

hints.title: Maximum Value Tracking
hints.text: Track the maximum positive integer x that satisfies the condition, returning -1 if no such integer exists.

hints.title: Hash Set Positive Complement Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass set building and single pass complement lookup.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested search for negative complements takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set enables O(1) existence queries for -x.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses hash set complement lookup or sorted two-pointer sweep to achieve linear time.
